name: find-loose
description: Find and re-seat the loose screw. After a conveyor jam, one of the sensor's two M3 screws or the corner bracket's forward M4 has worked loose. Find it and re-seat it until its preset driver clicks: green 2.5 mm/0.35 N m for M3, yellow 3 mm/0.60 N m for M4. Leave the other screws tight, the rail level and the reference flag home with the sensor detecting it, after releasing the stand.
